# --schema lists builtins under their own header first, then providers,
# with related functions together, and plain when piped.
bit --schema
stdout '\A[^\n]*Builtins[^\n]*\n\n'
stdout 'env\(name: string'
stdout 'docker\.image'
stdout 'basename\(path:[^\n]*\n[^\n]*dirname\(path:'
stdout '\n\n[^\n]*rust\.packages\([^\n]*\n[^\n]*rust\.dependencies\('
! stdout '\x1b'

# A filter keeps the header and only what matches.
bit --schema env
stdout '\A[^\n]*Builtins[^\n]*\n\n'
! stdout 'docker\.image'

-- BUILD.bit --
